invariants.rationale: Method performs element.getString and element.getInt; null would cause NPE.
tmjFile is used to resolve relative files, requiring non-nullness.
imageResolver is passed to downstream calls and almost certainly required to be non-null.
element is treated as an object (has fields, getString, getInt, get), so underlying type must support those operations.
Method begins by checking if a firstgid string is present; either 'has' or 'getString' yields information.
